changelog:
- Initial release of lygo-truthlightecho: generates harmonic echo audio sequences from ∫Truth×Light metrics (contrast, brightness, harmony, phi), integrating with LYGO RESONANCE and related creative tools.
- Supports input from images, JSON profiles (Glyph2Resonance, FractalWeaver), or manual values to compute or ingest Truth×Light, producing structured echo profiles.
- Maps computed metrics to audio parameters: root frequency, harmonic intervals, recursive echo delays, decay, and evolving modulation.
- Outputs include high-quality stereo WAV files, optional stems/MIDI, and full echo profiles for further processing or integration into agent/3-Brain creative systems.
- Batch processing and reproducibility via seed supported; integrates with army/TUI/agent workflows in the LYGO ecosystem.
summary: Generates harmonic echo sequences from ∫Truth×Light metrics. Integrates with LYGO RESONANCE engine and prior creative tools (Glyph2Resonance, FractalWeaver)....
